### UTC Date & Time

[November 23, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/nov-23-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

#### Glamsterdam

- EIP-8037/EIP-8038 feedback from teams
  - Led by @rahul-kothari
- EIP-8037 Spec Change Decision Tree
  - Toni will present a decision tree with all possible EIP-8037 spec changes
  - Goal: provide more context to client devs regarding what has been analyzed, not lock in decision (can wait until ACD-C/E)
  - Led by @nerolation
- @HubertRitzdorf-ChainSecurity opinion on fork development:
  - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2306#issuecomment-7099995295

#### Hegota

- Hegota Devnet Status: Bogota Devnet-2, Heze Devnet-2
  - Led by EthPandaOps
- Bogota Devnet 3 Discussion
  - Goal: start discussion rather than locking scope
  - Context:
    - https://forkcast.org/upgrade/hegota/priority-order/
  - Client team positions:
    - Should there be a Bogota Devnet 3 at all, or should we keep iterating on bogota-2?
    - If yes: which, if any, of the remaining CFI'd EIPs should go in, and why are they worth the extra testing surface?
  - Specs team position (@jochem-brouwer):
    - Prefer no new EIPs, to remove friction for PQ work landing in Hegotá
    - EIP-4758 (Deactivate SELFDESTRUCT) / EIP-8360 (TCREATE): 4758 is on bogota-2 but 8360 is not on any devnet. Either remove 4758 from Hegotá, or add 8360 to give smart contract devs an alternative and minimize potential friction.
  - EthPandaOps position (@qu0b):
    - https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-3
  - Led by @marioevz 

### EL Breakout

Led by @marioevz 

- TBD

  - Led by @jihoonsong
